facts.fact: The National Consumer Helpline toll-free number is 1915 (also 1800-11-4000)
facts.quote: using toll-free numbers 1915 or 1800-11-4000 , as well as through WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH App, web portal and UMANG App.

facts.fact: The helpline is available daily except national holidays, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM
facts.quote: 1800 11 4000 or 1915 Available daily except national holidays, 08:00 AM – 08:00 PM

facts.fact: Complaints can be sent by SMS to 8800001915
facts.quote: Register via SMS Send SMS to 8800001915 and we will get back to you.

facts.fact: Complaints can be sent on WhatsApp to 8800001915
facts.quote: You can register your grievance through whatsapp at 8800001915 .

facts.fact: Complaints can also be registered on consumerhelpline.gov.in, the NCH app or UMANG
facts.quote: Register your grievance through NCH APP Download App → OR Register your grievance through UMANG APP
Contact Details Email ID nch-ca[at]gov[dot]in Call to Register Your Grievance

summary: All NCH numbers, hours, SMS/WhatsApp, app/portal channels and email confirmed on consumerhelpline.gov.in.
